policy.title: Returns and exchanges policy
policy.description: Find the return conditions, how to make a request, and how refunds are processed.
policy.help_description: Have a question about your order? Contact the Core Care team through our available support channels.
policy.intro: Your satisfaction matters to us. Damaged products will be returned or compensated with wallet credit including shipping. For your safety, cosmetics, perfumes, personal care products, and products that have been used or opened cannot be returned.
policy.devices: Devices can be returned provided they have not been used or opened and are in their original condition as received from Core Care.
policy.fees_answer:
For an undamaged product returned in its original condition, the customer pays a return fee of SAR 19, deducted from the value of the returned product.
Core Care covers all return fees for damaged products.
policy.damaged_question: How can I return a damaged product?
policy.damaged_answer:
The Core Care customer service team will be happy to help. Send a ticket on your order or contact the store through its registered support channels.
The product must be in its original condition and packaging. It must not have been used, opened, or repackaged.
policy.offers_question: Can I return a damaged product purchased during a Core Care promotion?
policy.offers_answer: If a product purchased during a Core Care promotion arrives damaged, compensation is provided by shipping a replacement product or adding wallet credit equal to its value. Its value cannot be refunded to a bank account.
policy.lenses_question: Can I return contact lenses in their original condition?
policy.lenses_answer: For your safety, cosmetics, including contact lenses, cannot be returned even in their original condition.
policy.deadline_question: How long do I have to return a damaged product?
policy.deadline_answer: You can return a damaged product within 7 days of purchase.
policy.processing_question: How long does a damaged product return take?
policy.processing_answer: At Core Care, we work hard to ensure your satisfaction. The return process may take up to 10 business days.
policy.payment_question: How will I receive my refund?
policy.payment_answer:
A refund is processed after we receive the damaged product and verify its condition, according to the payment method used.
Credit card payments are refunded to the wallet or bank account. Cash on delivery payments are refunded as wallet credit.
policy.qitaf_question: Can Qitaf points be refunded to a bank account?
policy.qitaf_answer: Qitaf points exchanged for Core Care wallet credit cannot be refunded to a bank account.
policy.rajhi_question: Can Al Rajhi rewards be refunded to a bank account?
policy.rajhi_answer: Al Rajhi rewards exchanged for Core Care wallet credit cannot be refunded to a bank account.
policy.temporary_question: Can temporary credit be refunded to a bank account?
policy.temporary_answer: Temporary credit cannot be refunded or transferred to a bank account.
policy.license_description: You can view the details of the Core Care promotional license in the attached document.
